How it works

From "I need someone" to "it's done." In four steps.

01
Share your location

GPS detects where you are — or type any Eircode. Every result is ranked by distance from you.

02
Browse trusted local vendors

Filter by availability, price, language, community and verification tier. See real reviews from verified bookings.

03
Book in under a minute

Pick a slot, message the vendor, pay securely. Funds are held in escrow until the job is done.

04
Rate, review, rebook

Leave a verified review. Save favourites. Rebook your trusted pros in one tap.

Why people trust JaldiHelp

Three tiers of verification

Background check, credential check, or ID — every vendor has a tier badge before they can list.

Escrow payments

We hold your money until the job is done. No upfront risk.

Only verified reviews

Reviews are only possible after a completed booking. No fake stars.

Location-precise results

Every search is anchored to your GPS or Eircode. Distance is honest.
